entities.summary: Nussbaumersee is a small lake between Nussbaumen and Uerschhausen, both in the municipality of Hüttwilen in the Canton of Thurgau, Switzerland. It lies at an altitude of 434 metres above sea level, and its surface area is 25.2 ha. The lake has one small island. Hüttwilersee and Hasensee are located in the same valley.
